title: Retrospective evaluation of structured reporting and multimodal data integration in lung cancer
summary: Diagnosis and therapy of lung cancer are challenging and are therefore handled by multidisciplinary teams in highly specialized medical centers. Clinical, radiological and pathological parameters are evaluated to characterize the tumor and systemic tumor burden. To manage the abundance of data, a structured reporting system will be introduced in all aspects of diagnosis with downstream development of data integration for a clinical decision support system.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of the time period 2013-2022: patients with proven lung cancer who were seen by the lung tumor centre Munich and who have a complete, guideline-adherent data set on retrospective analysis

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histology based Diagnosis of lung cancer

2. Pulmonary lesions in F18 FDG PET/CT hybrid imaging.

3. Referral to the lung tumor centre Munich with concluding report of the center

4. Age > 18 years

5. Primary diagnosis of lung cancer; no prior treatment for lung cancer
Exclusion criteria:
1. Incomplete clinical, pathological or radiological information concerning guide-line relevant parameters

2. hybrid imaging using low-dose CT or without the use of iodine-containing contrast agent
